findings.failure_path: A coverage report or XML error response at the configured JUnit path parses successfully. With no testcase descendants, the helper returns empty results and no error. The collector then increments parsed_suites and omits the file from missing_files, allowing the default gate to see a successful empty suite.
findings.smallest_fix: Validate the supported JUnit root elements before accepting the parse. Test an unrelated XML root alongside a legitimate empty testsuite so valid zero-test runs keep their current behavior.

findings.failure_path: ElementTree can raise LookupError for an unknown encoding in the XML declaration. That exception escapes the new handler, so the report terminates before recording the suite or issuing its infrastructure-failure diagnostic.
findings.smallest_fix: Handle encoding lookup failures around ET.parse and add an unknown-encoding fixture to the existing malformed-input test.

findings.failure_path: Git propagates command-line configuration to child processes through GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS. The filter retains that variable. A report launched from a Git-driven parent can therefore read the parent's user.name and publish the wrong author even though the three-key mock test passes.
findings.smallest_fix: Remove GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS from the child environment. Verify the reported author with real Git in a temporary repository whose configured author differs from the inherited override.

findings.failure_path: The canonical append recipe reads the full 信息流转 value and later replaces it unconditionally. If two editors read the same value, both writes can succeed and the later one removes the earlier editor's entry. Checking the CLI return code cannot detect that loss.
findings.smallest_fix: Use a conditional update if the API supports one. Otherwise make exclusive writing for the record an explicit precondition at the recipe and direct concurrent editors through a serialized writer.

findings.failure_path: The batch example writes status or definition fields before reading and appending their history. A failed history read leaves the first change committed without its explanation. A failed first upsert merely sets field_ok to false, so the batch can exit zero with a requested record unchanged.
findings.smallest_fix: Read and prepare the history first, include it with the other fields in one per-record upsert, and raise on a failed upsert or return a nonzero batch result identifying failed records.

findings.failure_path: A successful CLI process whose JSON lacks data.items is treated as an empty final page. The lookup returns an empty or partial index, and the update loop warns and skips the requested IDs. This converts an unreadable inventory into an apparently successful batch.
findings.smallest_fix: Require the expected list shape on each page and raise on a malformed response. Treat an unresolved requested ID as a failed batch item.

findings.failure_path: The workflow promises a rolling 信息流转 history with 100 entries by default. The copied recipe concatenates every entry indefinitely and ignores TC_INFO_KEEP, so following the canonical example does not implement the retention contract.
findings.smallest_fix: Apply the skill's rolling-history rule when constructing the new value, including the documented zero-for-unlimited setting.

findings.failure_path: The preservation test configures only a corrupt suite, which forces parsed_suites to zero. A writer that replaces last-run.json whenever any suite parses would pass this test and could replace a complete baseline after one valid and one corrupt suite. The packet does not show the writer's mixed-run predicate.
findings.smallest_fix: Add one valid participating suite alongside the corrupt suite. Exercise the gate, assert exit 1, and compare the baseline bytes before and after. Guard snapshot replacement on complete participating results if that test fails.

findings.failure_path: Replacing both original headings with a combined heading breaks existing links ending in #step-8-list-and-search-existing-records or #step-9-update-records at the setup guide. The new outbound link helps readers only after they find the replacement section.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep both original headings as short forwarding sections, each linking directly to its relocated counterpart.

findings.failure_path: TAM_UPD#001 claims destination agreement under 多人编辑与漂移检查, but the changed 拉取现有记录 instruction is visibly under update 工作流. The source register at line 918 also names a combined Bitable destination heading that the new guide never defines. These are concrete counterexamples to the claimed locator verification.
findings.smallest_fix: Correct both destination pointers and make the preservation check resolve each survivor inside its named section. Regenerate the affected rows before counting them as verified.

findings.failure_path: This partition contains the 202-row SEW/TAM table but only cites the other 452 rows. It also omits the other size-critical entrypoint diffs and the implementations and tests for the fence, allowlist, and symlink gates. The aggregate tables alone cannot establish 654/654 carriers, the repository-wide size deltas, or the other suites' behavior for this release.
findings.smallest_fix: Bind the sibling partition results and full-tree size and carrier-check outputs to the same candidate. Keep batch-wide acceptance pending until those results can be reconciled.

findings.failure_path: M08–M10 attribute failures to pytest names that differ from the staged tests. For example, M08 names test_parse_junit_truncated_xml_warns_and_returns_empty, while the candidate adds test_parse_junit_malformed_xml_returns_empty. The ledger cannot trace those kills to the assertions being released.
findings.smallest_fix: Rerun the three mutations against the frozen test file and record the actual failing pytest node IDs and owning assertions from each run.

findings.failure_path: The closeout ends with boundary acceptance pending. It reports private R0 tokens but supplies no candidate-bound result for select-affected-tests.py --run, make test-repo-gates, or the remaining full pre-push gates. A release decision based on this ledger would omit explicit acceptance conditions.
findings.smallest_fix: Record the exact tested revision or tree, command, exit status, and result for each required lane, including the private audit's sanitized receipt. Leave outstanding lanes pending until their results exist.

findings.failure_path: The plan marks terminal-cli-dev inapplicable because flags and exit codes are preserved. On corrupt XML, the intended user-visible transition is from a traceback to a report, a filename diagnostic, and a deliberate gate exit. The added test calls internal functions and cannot establish that the command entrypoint delivers that transition.
findings.smallest_fix: Record the changed CLI behavior and add an offline invocation of the normal report command that checks the diagnostic, rendered infrastructure failure, and process exit status.

findings.failure_path: The plan says single-pass discovery halves filesystem traversal syscalls. Its own description of the old emptiness probe uses any(), which stops at the first matching file. On a tree with an early match, the removed work can be a small fraction of a full traversal.
findings.smallest_fix: State that the preliminary traversal is removed. Retain a numerical syscall reduction only if measured on an identified workload.

The report names malformed XML files on stderr. The Bitable recipe prints field-write errors but can exit zero, so automation cannot reliably detect an incomplete update.

One supplied obligation row names the wrong destination section. The other partitions' carrier counts, size totals, and suite results remain claims in this packet. The filesystem syscall reduction also exceeds the evidence shown.

The shared report gate accepts some unusable artifacts, and the write-finality test covers only a run with zero successful parses. The symlink and allowlist implementations are outside this partition.

The relocated Bitable recipe conflicts with the nearest contract's requirements to fail loudly and preserve existing state. The root contract's candidate-bound completion evidence is incomplete. Neither quoted contract needs to be weakened.
